# how-to-web Navbar

> Machine-readable reconstruction guidance for the how-to-web Navbar organism.

This path documents a framework-independent global website Navbar. Coding agents should use the Build DNA as the primary reconstruction contract. The visual examples demonstrate three implementations and are not the specification.

## Primary

- [Build DNA](./build-dna.json): Canonical reconstruction contract. Read this first.
- [Navbar reference](./index.md): LLM-friendly anatomy, behavior, responsive and accessibility contract.
- [Research](./RESEARCH.md): Current evidence and source links.
- [Human reference](./): Interactive showcase and self-review guidance.

## Examples

- [Simple](./examples/simple.json): Direct global navigation.
- [With Disclosures](./examples/with-disclosures.json): Navigation with disclosure groups.
- [Utility + Primary](./examples/utility-plus-primary.json): Primary plus service navigation.

## Source

- [GitHub source](https://github.com/blame76/how-to-web/tree/main/elements/navigation/navbar)

## Agent instruction

Reconstruct from Build DNA rather than copying HTML. Preserve the supplied information architecture, native link/button semantics, current-page state, disclosure behavior, responsive continuity and accessibility. Mobile is a responsive state, not a different navigation model. Ask for missing navigation decisions instead of inventing them.
